title: Inspect inputs and provider requests and force responses
statement: As a developer building tools around AI harnesses, I can inspect the input and provider traffic for an exercised binary and prescribe provider responses so that I can drive the behavior my application needs to handle.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The library API exposes the input sent to the binary during the test.
The library API exposes the requests received by the mock provider from the binary.
The consumer can use the library API to force a text response from the mock provider for the binary to process.
The consumer can prescribe a mock-provider response containing the tool-call semantics and arguments supported by the selected harness, such as a file-read call naming a fixture path.

When its normal permissions allow the requested operation, the real binary executes the prescribed tool call using its normal tool implementation; a prescribed file read reads the actual file on the target OS.
